what: RULE: Hook scripts must NEVER use __dirname or SCRIPT_DIR as project root for data access (.aide/, memories, tracking files). Always use 'cwd' from hook stdin JSON as PROJECT_ROOT. __dirname is only valid for packageRoot (finding dist/ and other package files). This applies to all JS scripts (recall-for-path.js, search-preview.js, session-inject.js) and all shell scripts.
why: Hardcoded __dirname as project root meant hooks only worked in the aide-v0 dev directory, not in any user's actual project. Caught during validation — hooks returned aide-v0's 50 memories instead of the test project's 10. Every future hook script must follow this rule.
